notes: the second isnad opens «وعن ابن شهاب» with no teacher of the compiler written in this text, so its group starts at ابن شهاب; nothing is inherited
both isnads carry the same ruling on the fetus, so they are two routes of one saying, not two sayings
«فقال الذي قضي عليه ... فقال رسول الله» : the Prophet is the end of the chain, not a link
